actions.title: Claim & 100% Complete Your Google Business Profile
actions.why: Google's AI Mode and Gemini extract business existence, opening hours, exact service boundaries, and review sentiment directly from Google Maps and your Google Business Profile before anything else.
steps: Sign into business.google.com and claim or verify your physical Sydney location.
Add all primary and secondary service categories (not just one generic category).
Upload at least 15 high-res photos of your team, branded vehicles, and completed local work.
Ensure your exact operating hours, public phone number, and suburb service areas are filled in.

actions.title: Surpass {topCompetitor}'s Review Count on Google
actions.why: AI engines strongly favor businesses with high review velocity and detailed review text. Currently, {topCompetitor} leads your local area with more frequent positive reviews.
steps: Send an automated SMS review link to every customer within 1 hour of job completion.
Ask satisfied customers to mention the specific service and suburb in their review.
Never offer incentives, discounts or compensation for reviews (violates Google policy & Australian Consumer Law).
Reply to 100% of reviews within 48 hours, weaving in keywords naturally.

actions.title: Get Listed on the Exact Sources AI Quoted
actions.why: When ChatGPT and Claude answered queries for your service, they cited authoritative Sydney directories and local platforms: {quotedSources}.
steps: Claim your profile on {firstSource} and ensure your service list is fully populated.
Build active listings across {remainingSources}.
Include rich business descriptions, photos, and links back to your verified website.

actions.title: Lock In Identical Business Details (NAP) Everywhere
actions.why: If AI finds conflicting phone numbers or addresses across Apple Maps, Bing, Yellow Pages and your website, it loses confidence in your business and drops you from recommendations.
steps: Standardise your Business Name, Street Address, and Phone Number (NAP) to match your legal entity.
Verify listings across Apple Business Connect, Bing Places for Business, and True Local.
Update legacy directories: Yellow Pages, Hotfrog, and your trade association registry.

actions.title: Answer The Exact Questions Customers Ask AI
actions.why: AI models failed to recommend you on {unansweredCount} key consumer prompts. Your website currently lacks clear conversational answers for those exact search intents.
steps: Publish dedicated service landing pages targeting '[Service] in {suburb}'.
Add an interactive FAQ block addressing common customer questions and transparent pricing.
Use structured Schema.org FAQPage markup so AI crawlers parse your answers directly.

actions.title: Fix The {issueCount} Critical Website & Crawler Issues Found
actions.why: AI search bots (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended) need fast, mobile-friendly, schema-rich web pages to index your business facts accurately.
steps: Resolve the urgent items identified in our automated website audit.
Ensure your robots.txt allows AI crawlers and provides an accessible llms.txt.
Add tap-to-call Australian phone formatting on all mobile views.

actions.title: Earn High-Trust Local Mentions Across Sydney
actions.why: AI engines assess domain authority through local ecosystem links, including Sydney trade associations, community sponsorships, and supplier partner directories.
steps: Get listed on your suppliers' 'Where to Buy / Authorised Installer' pages.
Sponsor a local Sydney sports team or community event with a website link.
Join your local chamber of commerce or Master Builders / Master Plumbers association.

actions.title: Track & Monitor Your AI Visibility Every Month
actions.why: AI recommendation algorithms and competitor activities change weekly. Ongoing tracking ensures you catch competitor ranking shifts before you lose phone calls.
steps: Run an AI Health Check on the 1st of every month to measure visibility score changes.
Compare top AI competitor shifts and adjust your directory presence accordingly.
